note: Compound heterozygous variants in MAPK8IP3 were directly shown to cause severe congenital hypotonia mimicking lethal spinal muscular atrophy with >60% reduction in JIP3.

evidence.text: Compound heterozygous variants in MAPK8IP3 were identified in a patient with severe congenital hypotonia mimicking lethal spinal muscular atrophy, with muscle biopsy showing a >60% decrease in JIP3 expression, suggesting an autosomal recessive lower motor neuron phenotype.

source.title: Compound heterozygous variants in MAPK8IP3 were detected in severe congenital hypotonia mimicking lethal spinal muscular atrophy
source.quote: Compound heterozygous rare variants (a splice and a missense) were detected in MAPK8IP3, inherited from the healthy parents. Western blot analysis in a muscle biopsy sample showed a more than 60% decrease in JIP3 expression. Here, we suggest a novel autosomal recessive phenotype of a lower motor neuron disease caused by JIP3 deficiency.
